name: Rte
description: Configuration of the Rte (Runtime Environment) module.

children.name: RteBswGeneral
children.description: General configuration parameters of the Bsw Scheduler section.

children.name: RteSchMVersionInfoApi
children.description: Enables the generation of the SchM_GetVersionInfo() API.

children.name: RteUseComShadowSignalApi
children.description: This parameter defines whether the ComShadowSignalAPIs ((Com_UpdateShadowSignal, Com_InvalidateShadowSignal, Com_ReceiveShadowSignal) are used or not.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: If this parameter is set to true the ShadowSignal APIs and Signal APIs (Com_SendSignal, Com_InvalidateSignal, Com_ReceiveSignal) are used. If this parameter is set to false only the Signal APIs (Com_SendSignal, Com_InvalidateSignal, Com_ReceiveSignal) are used.

children.name: RteBswModuleInstance
children.description: Represents one instance of a Bsw-Module configured on one ECU.

children.name: RteBswImplementationRef
children.description: Reference to the BswImplementation for which the Rte /SchM is configured.

children.name: RteBswModuleConfigurationRef
children.description: Reference to the ECU Configuration Values provided for this BswImplementation.

children.name: RteBswEventToTaskMapping
children.description: Maps a BswModuleEntity onto an OsTask based on the activating BswEvent. A BswModuleEntity can be activated by more than one BswEvent and thus be mapped to more than one OsTask. In the case of a BswSchedulableEntity executed via a direct function call this RteBswEventToTaskMapping is still specified but no RteBswMappedToTaskRef element is included. The RteBswPositionInTask parameter is necessary to provide an ordering of events invoked by the same RTE API.

children.name: RteBswActivationOffset
children.description: Activation offset in seconds.

children.name: RteBswImmediateRestart
children.description: When RteBswImmediateRestart is set to true the BswSchedulableEntitiy shall be immediately re-started after termination if it was activated by this BswEvent while it was already started.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: This parameter shall not be set to true when the mapped BswEvent refers to a BswSchedulableEntitiy which minimumStartInterval attribute is > 0.

children.name: RteBswPositionInTask
children.description: Each BswSchedulableEntity activation mapped to an OsTask has a specific position within the task execution.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: For periodic activation this is the order of execution. For event driver activation this is the order of evaluation which actual BswSchedulableEntity has to be executed. In case of direct function calls this parameter is necessary to provide an ordering of events when several ExecutableEntities are invoked by the same RTE API.

children.name: RteOsSchedulePoint
children.description: Introduce a schedule point by explicitly calling Os Schedule service after the execution of the ExecutableEntity. The Rte generator is allowed to optimize several consecutive calls to Os schedule into one single call if the ExecutableEntity executions in between have been skipped.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The absence of this parameter is interpreted as "NONE". It shall be considered an invalid configuration if the task is preemptable and the value of this parameter is not set to "NONE" or the parameter is absent.
metadata.LITERALS: CONDITIONAL AUTOSAR_ECUC NONE AUTOSAR_ECUC UNCONDITIONAL AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: RteBswEventRef
children.description: Reference to the BswEvent.

children.name: RteBswEventPredecessorSyncPointRef
children.description: The RteBswEventPredecessorSyncPointRef is necessary to provide a cross core synchronization in case of BswEvents triggered by the same event source but mapped to tasks belonging to different partitions on different cores.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The synchronization point must be reached by all referencing BswEvents before the execution in all related tasks is continued. In case of RteBswEventPredecessorSyncPointRef the BswModuleEntity activated by the mapped BswEvent is executed after the synchronization point is passed.

children.name: RteBswEventSuccessorSyncPointRef
children.description: The RteBswEventSuccessorSyncPointRef is necessary to provide a cross core synchronization in case of BswEvents triggered by the same event source but mapped to tasks belonging to different partitions on different cores.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The synchronization point must be reached by all referencing BswEvents before the execution in all related tasks is continued. In case of RteBswEventSuccessorSyncPointRef the BswModuleEntity activated by the mapped BswEvent is executed before the synchronization point is entered.

children.name: RteBswMappedToTaskRef
children.description: Reference to the OsTask the BswSchedulableEntity activated by the RteBswEventRef is mapped to.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: If no reference to the OsTask is specified the BswSchedulableEntity activated by this BswEvent is executed in the context of the caller.

children.name: RteBswUsedOsAlarmRef
children.description: If an OsAlarm is used to activate the OsTask this BswEvent is mapped to it shall be referenced here.

children.name: RteBswUsedOsEventRef
children.description: If an OsEvent is used to activate the OsTask this BswEvent is mapped to it shall be referenced here.

children.name: RteBswUsedOsSchTblExpiryPointRef
children.description: If an OsScheduleTableExpiryPoint is used to activate the OsTask this BswEvent is mapped to it shall be referenced here.

children.name: RteBswExclusiveAreaImpl
children.description: Represents one ExclusiveArea of one BswImplementation. Used to specify the implementation means of this ExclusiveArea.

children.name: RteExclusiveAreaImplMechanism
children.description: To be used implementation mechanism for the specified ExclusiveArea.

metadata.LITERALS: ALL_INTERRUPT_BLOCKING AUTOSAR_ECUC COOPERATIVE_RUNNABLE_PLACEMENT AUTOSAR_ECUC OS_INTERRUPT_BLOCKING AUTOSAR_ECUC OS_RESOURCE AUTOSAR_ECUC OS_SPINLOCK AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: RteBswExclusiveAreaRef
children.description: Reference to the ExclusiveArea for which the implementation mechanism shall be specified.

children.name: RteBswExclusiveAreaOsResourceRef
children.description: Optional reference to an OsResource in case RteExclusiveAreaImplMechanism is configured to OS_RESOURCE for this ExclusiveArea.

children.name: RteBswExclusiveAreaOsSpinlockRef
children.description: Optional reference to an OsSpinlock in case RteExclusiveAreaImplMechanism is configured to OS_SPINLOCK for this ExclusiveArea.

children.name: RteBswExternalTriggerConfig
children.description: Defines the configuration of Inter Basic Software Module Entity Triggering

children.name: RteBswTriggerSourceQueueLength
children.description: Length of trigger queue on the trigger source side.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The queue is implemented by the RTE. A value greater or equal to 1 requests an queued behavior. Setting the value of RteTriggerSourceQueueLength to 0 requests an none queued implementation of the trigger communication. If there is no RteBswTriggerSourceQueueLength configured for a Trigger Emitter the default value of 0 applies as well.

children.name: RteBswTriggerSourceRef
children.description: Reference to a Trigger instance in the role releasedTrigger of the related BSW Module instance.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The referenced Trigger has to belong to the same BSW Module instance as the RteBswModuleInstance owning this parameter configures.

children.name: RteBswInternalTriggerConfig
children.description: Defines the configuration of internal Basic Software Module Entity Triggering

children.name: RteBswTriggerSourceQueueLength
children.description: Length of trigger queue on the trigger source side.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The queue is implemented by the RTE. A value greater or equal to 1 requests an queued behavior. Setting the value of RteTriggerSourceQueueLength to 0 requests an none queued implementation of the trigger communication. If there is no RteBswTriggerSourceQueueLength configured for a Trigger Emitter the default value of 0 applies as well.

children.name: RteBswTriggerSourceRef
children.description: Reference to a BswInternalTriggeringPoint of the related BSW Module instance.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The referenced BswInternalTriggeringPoint has to belong to the same BSW Module instance as the RteBswModuleInstance owning this parameter configures.

children.name: RteBswRequiredClientServerConnection
children.description: Defines the connection between one requiredClientServerEntry and one providedClientServerEntry of a BswModuleDescription. This container shall be provided on the client side of the connection.

children.name: RteBswProvidedClientServerEntryRef
children.description: Reference the providedClientServerEntry for this connection.

children.name: RteBswRequiredClientServerEntryRef
children.description: Reference the requiredClientServerEntry for this connection.

children.name: RteBswProvidedClientServerEntryModInstRef
children.description: Reference to the RteBswModuleInstance configuration container which identifies the instance of the BSW Module.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Used with the RteBswProvidedClientServerEntryRef to unambiguously identify the BswModuleClientServerEntry instance.

children.name: RteBswRequiredModeGroupConnection
children.description: Defines the connection between one requiredModeGroup of this BSW Module instance and one providedModeGroup instance.

children.name: RteBswProvidedModeGroupRef
children.description: References the providedModeGroupPrototype to which this requiredModeGroup shall be connected.

children.name: RteBswRequiredModeGroupRef
children.description: References requiredModeGroupPrototype which shall be connected to the providedModeGroupPrototype.

children.name: RteModeDeclarationMappingSetRef
children.description: This defines the effective ModeDeclarationMappingSet in the case that the provided ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype and the required ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype are not compatible.

children.name: RteBswProvidedModeGrpModInstRef
children.description: Reference to the RteBswModuleInstance configuration container which identifies the instance of the BSW Module.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Used with the RteBswProvidedModeGroupRef to unambiguously identify the ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype instance.

children.name: RteBswRequiredSenderReceiverConnection
children.description: Defines the connection between one requiredData and one providedData of a BswModuleDescription. This container shall be provided on the receiver side of the connection.

children.name: RteBswProvidedVariableDataPrototypeRef
children.description: Reference the providedData for this connection.

children.name: RteBswRequiredVariableDataPrototypeRef
children.description: Reference the requiredData for this connection.

children.name: RteBswProvidedDataModInstRef
children.description: Reference to the RteBswModuleInstance configuration container which identifies the instance of the BSW Module.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Used with the RteBswProvidedVariableDataPrototypeRef to unambiguously identify the VariableDataPrototype instance.

children.name: RteBswRequiredTriggerConnection
children.description: Defines the connection between one requiredTrigger of this BSW Module instance and one releasedTrigger instance.

children.name: RteBswReleasedTriggerRef
children.description: References the releasedTrigger to which this requiredTrigger shall be connected.

children.name: RteBswRequiredTriggerRef
children.description: References one requiredTrigger which shall be connected to the releasedTrigger.

children.name: RteBswReleasedTriggerModInstRef
children.description: Reference to the RteBswModuleInstance configuration container which identifies the instance of the BSW Module.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Used with the RteBswReleasedTriggerRef to unambiguously identify the Trigger instance.

children.name: RteGeneration
children.description: This container holds the parameters for the configuration of the RTE Generation.

children.name: RteBypassSupport
children.description: General switch to enable and select the bypass support method.

children.name: RteCalibrationSupport
children.description: The RTE generator shall have the option to switch off support for calibration for generated RTE code. This option shall influence complete RTE code at once.

metadata.LITERALS: DOUBLE_POINTERED AUTOSAR_ECUC INITIALIZED_RAM AUTOSAR_ECUC NONE AUTOSAR_ECUC SINGLE_POINTERED AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: RteCodeVendorId
children.description: Holds the vendor ID of the generated Rte code.

children.name: RteDevErrorDetect
children.description: Switches the Default Error Tracer (Det) detection and notification ON or OFF.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: * true: enabled (ON). * false: disabled (OFF).

children.name: RteDevErrorDetectUninit
children.description: The Rte shall detect if it is started when its APIs are called, and the BSW Scheduler shall check if it is initialized when its APIs are called.

children.name: RteGenerationMode
children.description: Switch between the two available generation modes of the RTE generator.

children.name: RteInExclusiveAreaCheckEnabled
children.description: Enables the check for RTE_E_IN_EXCLUSIVE_AREA (for blocking APIs).

children.name: RteIocInteractionReturnValue
children.description: Defines whether the return value of RTE APIs is based on RTE-IOC interaction or RTE-COM interaction.

children.name: RteMeasurementSupport
children.description: The RTE generator shall have the option to switch off support for measurement for generated RTE code. This option shall influence complete RTE code at once.

children.name: RteOptimizationMode
children.description: Switch between the two available optimization modes of the RTE generator.

children.name: RteToolChainSignificantCharacters
children.description: If present, the RTE generator shall provide the list of C RTE identifiers whose name is not unique when only the first RteToolChainSignificantCharacters characters are considered.

children.name: RteValueRangeCheckEnabled
children.description: If set to true the RTE generator shall enable the value range checking for the specified VariableDataPrototypes.

children.name: RteVfbTraceClientPrefix
children.description: Defines an additional prefix for all VFB trace functions to be generated. With this approach it is possible to have debugging and DLT trace functions at the same time.

children.name: RteVfbTraceEnabled
children.description: The RTE generator shall globally enable VFB tracing when RteVfbTrace is set to "true".

children.name: RteVfbTraceFunction
children.description: The RTE generator shall enable VFB tracing for a given hook function when there is a #define in the RTE configuration header file for the hook function name and tracing is globally enabled.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Example: #define Rte_WriteHook_i1_p1_a_Start This also applies to VFB trace functions with a RteVfbTraceClientPrefix, e.g. Rte_Dbg_WriteHook_I1_P1_a_Start.

children.name: RteImplicitCommunication
children.description: Configuration of the Implicit Communication behavior to be generated.

children.name: RteCoherentAccess
children.description: If set to true the referenced VariableAccess'es of this RteImplicitCommunication container are in one CoherencyGroup.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Data values for Coherent Implicit Read Access'es are read before the first reading RunnbaleEntity starts and are stable during the execution of all the reading RunnableEntitys; except Coherent Implicit Write Access'es belongs to the same Coherency Group. Data values written by Coherent Implicit Write Access'es are available for readers not belonging to the Coherency Group after the last writing RunnableEntity has terminated. Please note that a Coherent Implicit Data Access can be defined for VariableAccess'es to same and different data element. Nevertheless all Coherent Implicit Data Access'es of one Coherency Group have to be executed in the same task.

children.name: RteImmediateBufferUpdate
children.description: If set to true the RTE will perform preemption area specific buffer update immediately before (for VariableAccess in the role dataReadAccess) resp. after (for VariableAccess in the role dataWriteAccess) Runnable execution.

children.name: RteVariableReadAccessRef
children.description: Reference to the VariableAccess in the dataReadAccess role.

children.name: RteVariableWriteAccessRef
children.description: Reference to the VariableAccess in the dataWriteAccess role.

children.name: RteSoftwareComponentInstanceRef
children.description: Reference to a SwComponentPrototype.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: This denotes the instances of the VariableAccess belonging to the RteImplicitCommunication.

children.name: RteInitializationBehavior
children.description: Specifies the initialization strategy for variables allocated by RTE with the purpose to implement VariableDataPrototypes.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The container defines a set of RteSectionInitializationPolicys and one RteInitializationStrategy which is applicable for this set.

children.name: RteInitializationStrategy
children.description: Definition of the initialization strategy applicable for the SectionInitializationPolicys selected by RteSectionInitializationPolicy.

children.name: RteSectionInitializationPolicy
children.description: This parameter describes the SectionInitializationPolicys for which a particular RTE initialization strategy applies.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The SectionInitializationPolicy describes the intended initialization of MemorySections. The following values are standardized in AUTOSAR Methodology: * '''NO-INIT''': No initialization and no clearing is performed. Such data elements must not be read before one has written a value into it. * '''INIT''': To be used for data that are initialized by every reset to the specified value (initValue). * '''POWER-ON-INIT''': To be used for data that are initialized by "Power On" to the specified value (initValue). Note: there might be several resets between power on resets. * '''CLEARED''': To be used for data that are initialized by every reset to zero. * '''POWER-ON-CLEARED''': To be used for data that are initialized by "Power On" to zero. Note: there might be several resets between power on resets.

children.name: RteInitializationRunnableBatch
children.description: This container corresponds to an Rte_Init_<shortName of this container> function invoking the mapped RunnableEntities.

children.name: RteOsInteraction
children.description: Interaction of the Rte with the Os.

children.name: RteModeToScheduleTableMapping
children.description: Provides configuration input in which Modes of a ModeDeclarionGroupPrototype of a Mode Manager a OsScheudleTable shall be active.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The Mode Manager is either specified as a SwComponentPrototype (RteModeSchtblMapSwc) or as a BSW-Module (RteModeSchtblMapBsw).

children.name: RteModeSchtblMapModeDeclarationRef
children.description: Reference to the ModeDeclarations.

children.name: RteModeScheduleTableRef
children.description: Reference to the OsScheduleTable which shall be active in the specified RteModeSchblMapModeDeclarationRefs.

children.name: RteModeSchtblMapBsw
children.description: Specifies an instance of a ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype of a Bsw-Module.

children.name: RteModeSchtblMapBswProvidedModeGroupRef
children.description: Reference to an instance of a ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype of a Bsw-Module.

children.name: RteModeSchtblMapBswInstanceRef
children.description: Reference to an instance specification of a Bsw-Module.

children.name: RteModeSchtblMapSwc
children.description: Specifies an instance of a ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype of a SwComponentPrototype.

children.name: RteModeSchtblMapSwcPortRef
children.description: Reference to the PPortPrototype of a SwComponentPrototype.

children.name: RteModeSchtblMapSwcInstanceRef
children.description: Reference to an instance specification of a SwComponentPrototype.

children.name: RteSyncPoint
children.description: The RteSyncPoint is necessary to provide an cross core synchronization in case of RteEvents triggered by the same event source but mapped to tasks belonging to different partitions on different cores.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The synchronization point must be reached by all referencing RteEvents before the execution in all related tasks is continued. In case of Rte(Bsw)EventSuccessorSyncPointRef the ExecutableEntity activated by the mapped event is executed before the synchronization point is entered. In case of Rte(Bsw)EventPredecessorSyncPointRef the ExecutableEntity activated by the mapped event is executed after the synchronization point is passed.

children.name: RteUsedOsActivation
children.description: Attributes used in the activation of OsTasks and Runnable Entities.

children.name: RteExpectedActivationOffset
children.description: Activation offset in seconds.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Important: This is a requirement from the Rte towards the Os/Mcu setup. The Rte Generator shall assume this activation offset to be fulfilled.

children.name: RteExpectedTickDuration
children.description: The expected tick duration in seconds which shall be configured to drive the OsScheduleTables or OsAlarm.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Important: This is a requirement from the Rte towards the Os/Mcu setup. The Rte Generator shall assume this tick duration to be fulfilled.

children.name: RteActivationOsAlarmRef
children.description: Reference to an OsAlarm.

children.name: RteActivationOsSchTblRef
children.description: Reference to an OsScheduleTable.

children.name: RteActivationOsTaskRef
children.description: Reference to an OsTask.

children.name: RtePostBuildVariantConfiguration
children.description: Specifies the PostbuildVariantSets for each of the PostBuild configurations of the RTE.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The shortName of this container defines the name of the RtePostBuildVariant.

children.name: RtePostBuildUsedPredefinedVariant
children.description: Reference to the PredefinedVariant element which defines the values for PostBuildVariationCriterion elements.

children.name: RteSwComponentInstance
children.description: Representation of one SwComponentPrototype located on the to be configured ECU. All subcontainer configuration aspects are in relation to this SwComponentPrototype.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The RteSwComponentInstance can be associated with either a AtomicSwComponentType or ParameterSwComponentType.

children.name: RteSoftwareComponentInstanceRef
children.description: Reference to a SwComponentPrototype.

children.name: RteEventToTaskMapping
children.description: Maps an instance of a RunnableEntity onto one OsTask based on the activating RTEEvent.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: In the case of a RunnableEntity executed via a direct function call this RteEventToTaskMapping is still specified but no RteMappedToTask element is included. The RtePositionInTask parameter is necessary to provide an ordering of events invoked by the same RTE API.

children.name: RteActivationOffset
children.description: Activation offset in seconds.

children.name: RteImmediateRestart
children.description: When RteImmediateRestart is set to true the RunnableEntitiy shall be immediately re-started after termination if it was activated by this RTEEvent while it was already started.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: This parameter shall not be set to true when the mapped RTEEvent refers to a RunnableEntity which minimumStartInterval attribute is > 0.

children.name: RteOsSchedulePoint
children.description: Introduce a schedule point by explicitly calling Os Schedule service after the execution of the ExecutableEntity. The Rte generator is allowed to optimize several consecutive calls to Os schedule into one single call if the ExecutableEntity executions in between have been skipped.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The absence of this parameter is interpreted as "NONE". It shall be considered an invalid configuration if the task is preemptable and the value of this parameter is not set to "NONE" or the parameter is absent.
metadata.LITERALS: CONDITIONAL AUTOSAR_ECUC NONE AUTOSAR_ECUC UNCONDITIONAL AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: RtePositionInTask
children.description: Each RunnableEntity mapped to an OsTask has a specific position within the task execution.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: For periodic activation this is the order of execution. For event driver activation this is the order of evaluation which actual RunnableEntity has to be executed. In case of direct function calls this parameter is necessary to provide an ordering of events when several ExecutableEntities are invoked by the same RTE API.

children.name: RteEventRef
children.description: Reference to the description of the RTEEvent which is pointing to the RunnableEntity being mapped. This allows a fine grained mapping of RunnableEntites based on the activating RTEEvent.

children.name: RteEventPredecessorSyncPointRef
children.description: The RteEventPredecessorSyncPointRef is necessary to provide a cross core synchronization in case of RteEvents triggered by the same event source but mapped to tasks belonging to different partitions on different cores.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The synchronization point must be reached by all referencing RteEvents before the execution in all related tasks is continued. In case of RteEventPredecessorSyncPointRef the RunnableEntity activated by the mapped RteEvent is executed after the synchronization point is passed.

children.name: RteEventSuccessorSyncPointRef
children.description: The RteEventSuccessorSyncPointRef is necessary to provide a cross core synchronization in case of RteEvents triggered by the same event source but mapped to tasks belonging to different partitions on different cores.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The synchronization point must be reached by all referencing RteEvents before the execution in all related tasks is continued. In case of RteEventSuccessorSyncPointRef the RunnableEntity activated by the mapped RteEvent is executed before the synchronization point is entered.

children.name: RteMappedToTaskRef
children.description: Reference to the OsTask the RunnableEntity activated by the RteEventRef is mapped to.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: If no reference to the OsTask is specified the RunnableEntity shall be executed via a direct function call. The fact that no reference to an OsTask is specified for a RunnableEntity does not necessarily imply that every RTE generator has to support the implementation of this RunnableEntity as a direct function call. The standard set of use cases for direct function calls that has to be supported by every RTE generator is explicitly stated as requirements in this document. For further optimization RTE vendors are free to support additional scenarios of direct function call implementations that are not explicitly required in this document.

children.name: RteUsedInitFnc
children.description: The RunnableEntity is executed during initialization in the context of the Rte_Init_<InitContainer> function.

children.name: RteUsedOsAlarmRef
children.description: If an OsAlarm is used to activate the OsTask this RteEvent is mapped to it shall be referenced here.

children.name: RteUsedOsEventRef
children.description: If an OsEvent is used to activate the OsTask this RteEvent is mapped to it shall be referenced here.

children.name: RteUsedOsSchTblExpiryPointRef
children.description: If an OsScheduleTableExpiryPoint is used to activate the OsTask this RteEvent is mapped to it shall be referenced here.

children.name: RteVirtuallyMappedToTaskRef
children.description: Optional reference to an OsTask where the activation of this RteEvent shall be evaluated. The actual execution of the Runnable Entity shall happen in the OsTask referenced by RteMappedToTaskRef.

children.name: RteExclusiveAreaImplementation
children.description: Specifies the implementation to be used for the data consistency of this ExclusiveArea.

children.name: RteExclusiveAreaImplMechanism
children.description: To be used implementation mechanism for the specified ExclusiveArea.

metadata.LITERALS: ALL_INTERRUPT_BLOCKING AUTOSAR_ECUC COOPERATIVE_RUNNABLE_PLACEMENT AUTOSAR_ECUC OS_INTERRUPT_BLOCKING AUTOSAR_ECUC OS_RESOURCE AUTOSAR_ECUC OS_SPINLOCK AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: RteExclusiveAreaRef
children.description: Reference to the ExclusiveArea.

children.name: RteExclusiveAreaOsResourceRef
children.description: Optional reference to an OsResource in case RteExclusiveAreaImplMechanism is configured to OS_RESOURCE for this ExclusiveArea.

children.name: RteExternalTriggerConfig
children.description: Defines the configuration of External Trigger Event Communication for Software Components

children.name: RteTriggerSourceQueueLength
children.description: Length of trigger queue on the trigger source side.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The queue is implemented by the RTE. A value greater or equal to 1 requests an queued behavior. Setting the value of RteTriggerSourceQueueLength to 0 requests an none queued implementation of the trigger communication. If there is no RteTriggerSourceQueueLength configured for a Trigger Emitter the default value of 0 applies as well.

children.name: RteSwcTriggerSourceRef
children.description: Reference to a Trigger instance in the pPortPrototype of the related component instance.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The referenced Trigger instance has to belong to the same software component instance as the RteSwComponentInstance owning this parameter configures.

children.name: RteInternalTriggerConfig
children.description: Defines the configuration of Inter Runnable Triggering for Software Components

children.name: RteTriggerSourceQueueLength
children.description: Length of trigger queue on the trigger source side.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The queue is implemented by the RTE. A value greater or equal to 1 requests an queued behavior. Setting the value of RteTriggerSourceQueueLength to 0 requests an none queued implementation of the trigger communication. If there is no RteTriggerSourceQueueLength configured for a Trigger Emitter the default value of 0 applies as well.

children.name: RteSwcTriggerSourceRef
children.description: Reference to an InternalTriggeringPoint of the related component instance.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The referenced InternalTriggeringPoint has to belong to the same software component instance as the RteSwComponentInstance owning this parameter configures.

children.name: RteNvRamAllocation
children.description: Specifies the relationship between the AtomicSwComponentType's NVRAMMapping / NVRAM needs and the NvM module configuration.

children.name: RteNvmRamBlockLocationSymbol
children.description: This is the name of the linker object name where the NVRam Block will be mirrored by the Nvm.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: This symbol will be resolved into the parameter "NvmRamBlockDataAddress" from the "NvmBlockDescriptor".

children.name: RteNvmRomBlockLocationSymbol
children.description: This is the name of the linker object name where the NVRom Block will be accessed by the Nvm.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: This symbol will be resolved into the parameter "NvmRomBlockDataAddress" from the "NvmBlockDescriptor".

children.name: RteSwNvBlockDescriptorRef
children.description: Reference to the NvBlockDescriptor in case the RTE needs to call the NvM directly (e.g. for the supportDirtyFlag feature).

metadata.INTRODUCTION: XOR

children.name: RteSwNvRamMappingRef
children.description: Reference to the SwSeriveDependency which is used to specify the NvBlockNeeds.

children.name: RteNvmBlockRef
children.description: Reference to the used NvM block for storage of the NVRAMMapping information.

children.name: RteSwComponentType
children.description: Representation of one SwComponentType for the base of all configuration parameter which are affecting the whole type and not a specific instance.

children.name: RteBypassSupportEnabled
children.description: Individual switch to enable the bypass support for this software component type.

children.name: RteComponentTypeRef
children.description: Reference to either AtomicSwComponentType or ParameterSwComponentType.

children.name: RteImplementationRef
children.description: The Implementation which shall be assigned to the SwComponentType.

children.name: RteComponentTypeCalibration
children.description: Specifies for each ParameterSwComponentType or AtomicSwComponentType whether calibration is enabled.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: If references to SwAddrMethod are provided in RteCalibrationSwAddrMethodRef only ParameterDataPrototypes with the referenced SwAddrMethod shall have software calibration support enabled.

children.name: RteCalibrationSupportEnabled
children.description: Enables calibration support for the specified ParameterSwComponentType or AtomicSwComponentType.

children.name: RteCalibrationSwAddrMethodRef
children.description: Reference to the SwAddrMethod for which software calibration support shall be enabled.
